notes.title: Drops
notes.content:
Hi Capybaras!

We launched with a small problem, fortunately it has now been solved and the items are drop correctly. 

Here are the percentage chances of getting an item for game time:


 [color=#a3a3a3]gray[/color]  󠀡󠀡  󠀡󠀡 -> 90%
 [color=#23eb00]green[/color]  -> 8%
 [color=#003cff]blue [/color] 󠀡󠀡  󠀡󠀡  󠀡󠀡 -> 1%
 [color=#8000e8]purple[/color] -> 0.1%
 [color=#000000]key[/color] 󠀡󠀡  󠀡󠀡  󠀡󠀡  󠀡󠀡 -> 0.9%
